placeName.zh-CN: 中国云南省腾冲市（砚湖公园至和顺古镇双虹桥）
placeName.en: Tengchong, Yunnan, China (Yanhu Park to Shuanghong Bridge, Heshun Ancient Town)

details.direction: Point-to-point from Yanhu Park in Tengchong to Shuanghong Bridge in Heshun Ancient Town, crossing the Gaoligong foothills
details.distanceMethod: The 2026 official regulations give 168 km (approx.), 8,540 m of cumulative ascent and 8,550 m of cumulative descent. The distance is an official approximation, not a survey measurement.
details.elevationMethod: The 2026 official regulations give 8,540 m cumulative ascent and 8,550 m cumulative descent for MGU. No per-checkpoint elevation table was obtained.
details.attribution: 2026 ANTA GUANJUN Tengchong Gaoligong Ultra / 腾冲市教育体育局、高黎贡山国家级自然保护区保山管护局等主办，北京行知探索文化发展集团运营。The regulations require every MGU runner to download the GPX track onto a phone, but no public GPX download link, licence or copyright statement was found. This site therefore draws no track, hosts no file, and uses a town-level map anchor rather than an official start-line coordinate.
